comment: Where scripts/licences.py reads the licence texts it cannot discover by itself. Crates, npm packages, cores and fonts are found from the lockfiles, core-pins.json and the tracked font files; this names the rest. A text is a file of this repository (repo), a file of the fork at its checked-out commit (fork), the first comment or the last `count` comments of a fork file (forkComment, forkLastComment: the library carries its licence nowhere else), a member of a pinned archive (pin, member), or a pinned URL (url). {version}, {commit} and {revision} in a URL are the component's pin's. `path` is the fork folder a library's sources are in: a player build that compiles a file under it uses the component, and a build that compiles a deps/ folder no component names is still made into a kit, with a warning naming the folder: a missing licence never removes or refuses anything. `versionDefine` reads a vendored library's version from a fork file. `copyright` is a notice we show under a component's title, in its entry, the index and the About views. `always` components are in every player; `platforms` limits one to a platform's players, with `toolchain` naming the file its toolchain installs, which scripts/build_kit.py compares with the text here, warning of a difference. `inGames` data ships in every exported game, so scripts/build_kit.py puts its entry in the kit.
